import time
from collections import defaultdict
from ..models.transaction import VerificationResult


class RateLimiter:
    def __init__(self, max_requests_per_minute=60):
        self.max_requests = max_requests_per_minute
        self.requests = defaultdict(list)

    def verify(self, transaction):
        current_time = time.time()
        user_requests = self.requests[transaction.user_id]

        # Clean old requests (older than 1 minute)
        self.requests[transaction.user_id] = [
            req_time for req_time in user_requests
            if current_time - req_time < 60
        ]

        if len(self.requests[transaction.user_id]) >= self.max_requests:
            return VerificationResult(
                False,
                f"Rate limit exceeded: {self.max_requests} requests per minute"
            )

        self.requests[transaction.user_id].append(current_time)
        return VerificationResult(True, "Rate limit check passed")
